title: Kuaishou’s Kling Picks Banks for $1 Billion-Plus Hong Kong IPO
text:
Kling AI, a spun-off unit of Chinese video app Kuaishou Technology, has picked banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg reported.
